title: Questions, information needed and the answer that unblocks each decision
rule: A question appears here only if a decision actually depends on it. Each row names who can answer it and what it unblocks; none of them is answered by this session on the owner's behalf.

rows.question: Which price source, if any, will be authorised?
rows.why_it_matters: Nothing market-related can be published without it. The site's residual, ROI and CLV columns are all blank or labelled hypothetical until this is answered.

rows.question: Is a licensed feed acceptable, or must every number come from a free public page?
rows.why_it_matters: Changes the entire collection design, and the answer decides whether the depth/snap items are reachable at all.

rows.question: What counts as a 'reward' in the competition?
rows.why_it_matters: No reward has been awarded and none will be until the owner defines one.

rows.question: Should this site replace the root dashboard, or live beside it?
rows.why_it_matters: There are now more than 30 NFL namespaces. One entry point is a product decision.

rows.question: Should the leaderboard's official sample be frozen at the 136-game log (weeks 1-9) or extended each week?
rows.why_it_matters: The arithmetic now matches the brief exactly (weeks 1-9 = 136 final games). What is still the owner's call is whether the graded sample may grow past 136 as week 10+ results arrive, or whether a frozen 136-game sample is the permanent reference.

rows.question: Will the owner permit a scheduled collector to run in this repository?
rows.why_it_matters: Without it there is no multi-day history, so no surprise-based injury feature and no honest ablation.
rows.unblocks: blocks R21, R27, R28, R51, R52

rows.question: How much compute and wall-clock time per week is acceptable?
rows.why_it_matters: The bootstrap and placebo tests are cheap now (under two seconds); a per-club interval plus a leave-one-game-out stability check multiplies that, still seconds.

rows.question: Is the club abbreviation set in this namespace the one the owner wants displayed?
rows.why_it_matters: nfl.com prints AZ and LA rather than ARI and LAR; this site keeps what the official page prints.

rows.question: Should a tie be scored as half a win in any accuracy figure?
rows.why_it_matters: The official standings count ties as half a win, but an accuracy metric counting a tie as 'correct' would be a modelling claim, not a fact. This namespace excludes them and publishes the count.

rows.question: Does the owner want the excluded/incomplete games shown prominently?
rows.why_it_matters: Two Week 10 fixtures are absent from every metric. They are listed on the results page and in the data; prominence is a design choice.

rows.question: What is the minimum evidence the owner will accept as 'skill'?
rows.why_it_matters: The registered gate is a week-cluster lower bound on Brier skill. If a different bar is intended (e.g. a full season of prospective forecasts), it should be registered before the season ends.

rows.question: Are the peer namespaces' availability numbers to be treated as verified?
rows.why_it_matters: This namespace found 348 player rows where peers publish 347 and 279. One of those is wrong, or the page changed; the owner should pick one canonical capture.
